basic_details.job_title: MGU MBA Course Mentor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, is filling one MBA Course Mentor post on contract for one year at its Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE), for the Online MBA programme. The post is for OBC category candidates only. Applications are sent by email to [email protected] and are accepted until 19 November 2026. The notice does not say whether this date is for receipt or dispatch. The monthly pay is Rs. 40,000.

qualification.details: Qualification: a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks in a related subject, and UGC/CSIR-NET or Ph.D. Age: not more than 50 years as on 1 January 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Category: the vacancy is reserved for the OBC category. Type of appointment: on contract basis, for one year. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: About MGU
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University has its address at Priyadarsini Hills P.O., Kottayam, Kerala, India, 686560. The notice dated 10 November 2026 was issued by its Public Relations Officer. The post is for the university's Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE), which runs the Online MBA programme.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to [email protected] by 19 November 2026. Candidates who are interested may apply until that date. The notice does not give an email subject line, an application form or a list of enclosures.

Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many MBA Course Mentor vacancies has MGU announced?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University has announced one MBA Course Mentor vacancy at its Centre for Distance and Online Education.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Course Mentor post?
faq.answer: The last date is 19 November 2026. The notice does not say whether this is a date of receipt or of dispatch.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the MGU MBA Course Mentor post?
faq.answer: The qualification is a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks in a related subject, and UGC/CSIR-NET or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MGU Course Mentor post?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 50 years as on 1 January 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the MGU MBA Course Mentor?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the MGU Course Mentor post?
faq.answer: Send your application by email to [email protected] on or before 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is the MGU Course Mentor job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract basis for one year.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for this MGU vacancy?
faq.answer: Only OBC category candidates, because the vacancy is reserved for that category. They must also meet the qualification and the age limit of 50 years as on 1 January 2026.
